items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: except Tommy Newsom, he doesn’t make the tours.

ctx.x: I can recall Johnny sitting there, and looking over there, and saying your name, and he knew all the guys in the band.

Yeah. He was great. I’ll tell you what, he was a very personal, private person. But, when it come to the band, he was very protective of us, man. He would always come and listen to us rehearse, and he knew every one of us, and always went out of his way to be good to us. You know very few people ever got to see his home, and where he lives. The band did. Absolutely. He was a great guy. I haven’t seen him in the last couple or three years. I know about two or three years ago, when Doc and the band, we go out and…
